object.description: Steps: Run PaceWindowTest 'sub-0-5 mps speed keeps lastGood' (the 'empty window' and 'single sample' tests cover the same rule for fewer than two location fixes). Expected: With a window of 0.4 m/s the returned pace equals the previous pace of 420 s/km. The 10 s window length and the initial 0 s/km are not proven here (see PACE-STS-42).
